Market today: The mood is cautious on tech, with headlines highlighting AI's costly build-out potentially complicating inflation for the Fed, and a "Big Short" investor seeing an Achilles' heel in the AI boom. Executive departures at OpenAI add to the uncertainty. These factors could weigh on your tech/chip heavy book.

Your holdings: SOXL is down 40.28% and SPAL is down 39.29%. Both are leveraged ETFs, meaning drawdowns hurt extra, especially on margin. Their current stops are either far off or already breached, demanding immediate attention.

Watch: Keep an eye on any further signs of inflation from AI build-out and how the Fed reacts. Also, monitor executive stability in key AI players.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your leveraged positions given the current market sentiment and your margin exposure.
plays: Review SOXL: Your stop at 200 is far from the current price of 151.98. Given the -40.28% loss and leveraged nature, consider adjusting your stop or trimming the position.
Address SPAL: The stop at 21.38 has been breached, with the price now at 15.27 and a -39.29% loss. This leveraged position needs immediate attention; consider exiting or setting a new, tighter stop.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
